date.original_date_text: 明宪宗成化八年九月三十日

place: 浙江绍兴府余姚县瑞云楼
description_en: Wang Shouren is born at Ruiyun Tower, Yuyao, Zhejiang.

description_zh: 中进士，名列二甲第七名。
description_en: Passes the jinshi examination, ranked seventh in the second class.

description_zh: 因上疏辩护言官戴铣等，触怒宦官刘瑾，遭廷杖四十，贬为贵州龙场驿丞。
description_en: Submits memorial defending censors including Dai Xian; offends eunuch Liu Jin; receives 40 strokes of the court rod and is exiled to Guizhou as Longchang post-station master.

description_zh: 龙场悟道：在极端困苦中静坐沉思，悟出“圣人之道，吾性自足”，形成心学基本洞见。
description_en: Longchang Enlightenment: In extreme hardship, through quiet meditation, realizes 'the Way of the Sage is complete within my own nature,' the founding insight of his philosophy.

description_zh: 受命南赣巡抚，平定江西、福建、广东交界地区民变。
description_en: Appointed Grand Coordinator of Southern Jiangxi; suppresses peasant revolts in Jiangxi-Fujian-Guangdong border region.

description_zh: 宁王朱宸濠起兵叛乱。王阳明集结约三万三千兵力，约三十五日平定叛乱，鄱阳湖之战中生擒朱宸濠。
description_en: Prince of Ning Zhu Chenhao launches rebellion. Wang assembles ~33,000 troops, suppresses rebellion in ~35 days, captures Zhu Chenhao at Battle of Lake Poyang.

description_zh: 受命总督两广军务，平定思恩、田州土司之乱及断藤峡瑶民起事。
description_en: Appointed Supreme Commander of Guangdong and Guangxi; suppresses Si'en and Tianzhou chieftain uprisings and Yao rebellion at Duanteng Gorge.

description_zh: 天泉证道：出征广西前，与弟子王畿、钱德洪论道，留下“四句教”。
description_en: Tianquan Bridge Teaching: Before departing for Guangxi, holds philosophical dialogue with disciples Wang Ji and Qian Dehong, delivering the Four-Sentence Teaching.

date.original_date_text: 嘉靖七年十一月二十九日

place: 江西南安府青龙铺舟中（今大余县）
description_zh: 卒于归途舟中，享年五十七岁（虚岁）。
description_en: Dies on a boat at Qinglongpu, Nan'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, while traveling north, aged 57 sui.

description_zh: 隆庆元年，追赠新建侯，谥文成。
description_en: Posthumously promoted to Marquis of Xinjian and given the title Wencheng.

description_zh: 万历十二年，获从祀孔庙。
description_en: Offered sacrifice in the Confucian Temple (congsi kongmiao).
